field_contract.source_core: Event id index from original PRIBES meta.xml
field_contract.site_identity_rule: Normalize original source locationID by Unicode NFKD, ascii fold then retain only uppercase A-Z 0-9; never use coordinates as fallback. Any site ID reused across different islands is not a single physical site.
field_contract.source_equal_effort_rule: Every selected original site Event must have positive numeric sampleSizeValue identical across all six BALA-overlap islands, and a single normalized nonempty sampleSizeUnit; source protocol nonempty, with at most 1 distinct normalized samplingProtocol in original six island selected source sites. If violated terminal before any PRIBES species read.
field_contract.duplicate_site_rule: If source 80 Event records identify only 79 physical locationID keys, select lexicographically smallest ORIGINAL Event CORE ID within each exact normalized island+locationID key and ignore any secondary original Event on that site; this is fixed before Event values, never based on taxon count. If any same site Event has differing method or coordinate >0.0003 degrees, terminal, not imputed.
field_contract.physical_site_count_gate: Original unique independent site count 79 OR 80 both accepted with published discrepancy reported. At least 4 independent selected sites per EACH six overlap island (minimum >=24 physical source sites total), and all seven published original islands represented. No after-exposure selective island dropout.
field_contract.original_location_quality: decimalLatitude and decimalLongitude finite for all selected source sites; report only max repeated-site discrepancy, not actual coordinate.
field_contract.site_years_not_equal: Report selected site survey year ranges per island; original BALA forest trends end 2019–2022 and PRIBES field sites span 2019–2025, so ecological temporal response and source predictor are asynchronous.
field_contract.site_records_output: Only country/island n, year distribution, method/effort vocabulary counts, original Event-source SHA256, selected original source-coreID SHA256; do not emit original source localityID, raw date, coordinates, or taxa.

next_science_if_event_pass: Freeze separate v1.322 original Occurrence response and rank+origin vocabulary gate then one-shot forest homogenization against introduced ruderal Coleoptera ubiquity, fixed negative control native Beetle site similarity. Parent BALA raw biology must remain sealed.
